2023-4289-4518-6965.description:
Cast Kor Skyfisher by paying its mana cost.
Aragorn triggers, creating a 1/1 Human Soldier creature token.
When Kor Skyfisher enters, it triggers.
Holding priority, activate Kor Skyfisher and the Human Soldier token by tapping them, adding {1}{W}.
Resolve the Kor Skyfisher ability, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat.

requires.n: Creature Castable for One Colored Mana

678-1531-5670--52.easyPrerequisites: Your life total is at least 2.
678-1531-5670--52.description:
Activate Warren Soultrader by paying 1 life and sacrificing the nontoken creature that can be cast using one colored mana.
When the creature dies, Deathgreeter and Enduring Renewal trigger.
Resolve the Deathgreeter trigger, causing you to gain 1 life
Resolve the Enduring Renewal trigger, returning the creature from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve the Warren Soultrader ability, creating a Treasure token.
Activate the Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding one mana of any color.
Cast the creature by paying its mana cost.
Repeat.

2595-4694-5256-7306.easyPrerequisites: Combine Guildmage does not have summoning sickness.
2595-4694-5256-7306.notablePrerequisites: You control at least one additional creature with a +1/+1 counter on it.
2595-4694-5256-7306.description:
Activate Combine Guildmage's first ability by paying {1}{G} and tapping it, causing each creature you control to enter with an additional +1/+1 counter this turn.
Activate Altar of Dementia by sacrificing a creature with a +1/+1 counter on it.
When that creature dies, The Ooze triggers, creating a Mutagen artifact token for each +1/+1 counter on the sacrificed creature. These artifacts are also 0/0 creatures due to March of the Machines.
Each Mutagen artifact creature token enters with at least one +1/+1 counter on it due to Combine Guildmage.
Resolve the Altar of Dementia ability, milling the targeted player a number of cards equal to the sacrificed creature's power.
Repeat from step 2.

requires.n: Zombie Creature castable for one colored mana

728-3249-6723-7968--206.easyPrerequisites: Grimgrin does not have summoning sickness.
728-3249-6723-7968--206.description:
Activate Grimgrin's ability from A Realm Reborn by tapping Grimgrin, adding one mana.
Activate Grimgrin by sacrificing the zombie castable for one mana, untapping Grimgrin and putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Activate Grimgrin's ability from A Realm Reborn by tapping Grimgrin, adding one mana.
Activate Havengul Lich by paying {1}, allowing you to cast the zombie castable for one mana from your graveyard this turn.
Cast that zombie spell from your graveyard by paying it mana cost.
When you cast that zombie or when it enters, Diregraf Colossus triggers, creating a creature token.
Activate Grimgrin by sacrificing the creature token, untapping Grimgrin and putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Repeat.

277-851-3129-7824-7942.description:
Activate Saurian Explorer by paying {6}, creating eight tapped New Planet tokens due to the three token doublers.
When the New Planet tokens enter, Tiller Engine triggers eight times, untapping the New Planets.
Activate six of the tokens by tapping them, adding {6}.
Repeat

330-4522-7839.easyPrerequisites:
You control another creature or artifact.
You control your commander.
330-4522-7839.notablePrerequisites: Quest for Pure Flame has at least four quest counters on it.
330-4522-7839.description:
Activate Quest for Pure Flame by removing four quest counters from it and sacrificing it.
Activate your commander using the ability granted to it by Street Urchin by paying {1} and sacrificing another creature or artifact, dealing 2 damage to Smaug due to Quest for Pure Flame.
Smaug triggers, creating two Treasure tokens.
Activate a Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {1}.
Repeat from step 2.

uses.battlefieldCardState: attached to any other creature you control

955-3259-3699.notablePrerequisites:
At least one opponent cannot block creatures you control.
You control a creature token.
955-3259-3699.description:
Deal combat damage using the creature that has Breath of Fury attached and Cadira, triggering Breath of Fury and Cadira.
Resolve the Cadira trigger, creating at least one creature token.
Resolve the Breath of Fury trigger, causing you to sacrifice the creature it is attached to, then attach Breath of Fury to a creature token, then causing you to untap all creatures you control and to get an additional combat phase after this one. 
Repeat each combat phase.

1003-3558-5049-6516.easyPrerequisites:
It is an opponent's turn.
One of the {0}-cost creatures must be in your hand, with the other being on the battlefield.
1003-3558-5049-6516.description:
During an opponent's turn, cast the {0}-cost creature in your hand by paying {0}.
Glen Elendra Pranksters triggers, returning the other {0}-cost creature from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the spell from step 1.
Repeat.

413-1263-4871-6026.description:
Activate Blasting Station by tapping it and sacrificing Bloodsoaked Champion.
When Bloodsoaked Champion dies, Field of Souls and Pitiless Plunderer trigger, creating a creature token and a Treasure token.
When the creature token enters, Blasting Station triggers, untapping Blasting Station
Resolve the Blasting Station ability from step 1.
Activate Blasting Station by tapping it and sacrificing the creature token.
When the creature token dies, Pitiless Plunderer triggers, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Blasting Station ability.
Activate the Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {1}{B}.
Activate Bloodsoaked Champion by paying {1}{B}, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Bloodsoaked Champion enters, Blasting Station triggers, untapping Blasting Station
Repeat.

215-955-5709.notablePrerequisites: You control at least four Forests.
215-955-5709.description:
Activate Rofellos by tapping it, adding an amount of {G}.
Activate Temur Sabertooth by paying {1}{G}, returning Rofellos from the battlefield to your hand.
Cast Rofellos by paying its mana cost.
Repeat.

132-1978-7685.description:
Activate Myr Welder using Arc Reactor's ability by tapping it, adding {C}{C}{C}.
If Voltaic Construct is on the battlefield, activate Voltaic Construct by paying {2}, untapping Myr Welder. Otherwise, activate Myr Welder using Voltaic Construct's ability by paying {2}, untapping Myr Welder.
Repeat.

3532-4928-5078-7692.easyPrerequisites: There is a removable counter on a creature you control.
3532-4928-5078-7692.description:
Activate Sensei's Divining Top's second ability by tapping it, causing you to draw a card and put Sensei's Divining Top on top of your library.
Cast Sensei's Divining Top by paying {0} and removing a counter from a creature you control.
Forgotten Ancient triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Repeat.

uses.battlefieldCardState: attached to another creature you control

3259-5223-7262.easyPrerequisites: There are creature cards in your library.
3259-5223-7262.notablePrerequisites: An opponent cannot block creatures you control.
3259-5223-7262.description:
Declare Raph & Mikey and the creature with Breath of Fury attached as attackers.
Raph & Mikey triggers, revealing a creature card from your library and putting it onto the battlefield tapped and attacking.
Deal combat damage using the creature that has Breath of Fury attached. 
Breath of Fury triggers, causing you to sacrifice the creature it is attached to, then attach Breath of Fury to the creature put onto the battlefield in step 2, and then causing you to untap all creatures you control and to get an additional combat phase after this one. 
Repeat each combat phase until you have no creatures left in your library.
3259-5223-7262.notes: The number of combat phases you can get will be equal to the number of creature you control (excluding those listed in this combo) plus the number of creatures in your library plus 1.

2267-4798-5686-7178.notablePrerequisites: You control at least one additional creature.
2267-4798-5686-7178.description:
Activate Iron-Shield Elf by discarding Ovalchase Daredevil.
Activate Shilgengar's first ability by sacrificing another creature, creating a Blood token.
When the Blood enters the battlefield, Ovalchase Daredevil triggers, returning Ovalchase Daredevil from your graveyard to your hand.
Tormod triggers, creating a 2/2 Zombie creature token.
Repeat.

321-341-399-2475-6707.description:
Cast Metallic Sliver by paying {0}.
When Metallic Sliver enters, it triggers, dealing 1 damage to target player or planeswalker and causing you to gain 2 life due to its ability and lifelink.
Activate Metallic Sliver by paying 2 life, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat.

5170-5231-6132-6634.description:
Activate Thermopod by sacrificing Metamorphosis Fanatic.
When Metamorphosis Fanatic dies, Al Bhed Salvagers triggers, causing you to gain 1 life and target opponent to lose 1 life.
Activate Thermopod by sacrificing Junji.
When Junji dies, it and Al Bhed Salvagers trigger.
Resolve the Al Bhed Salvagers trigger, causing you to gain 1 life and target opponent to lose 1 life.
Resolve the Junji trigger, returning Metamorphosis Fanatic from your graveyard to the battlefield and causing you to lose 2 life.
When Metamorphosis Fanatic enters, it triggers, returning Junji from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat.

719-4050-5310-6879.description:
Cast Bloodghast by paying {B}{B}.
When Bloodghast enters as an Ally due to Xenograft, Haru triggers, earthbending a land.
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Bloodghast.
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing a land creature.
When the land creature dies, Haru triggers, returning the land from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When the land enters, Bloodghast triggers, returning itself from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Bloodghast enters as an Ally due to Xenograft, Haru triggers, earthbending a land.
Repeat from step 3.
719-4050-5310-6879.notes: If the chosen land can enter untapped and produce mana, you may do so each iteration to get infinite mana of those color(s) and type(s).

518-3584-6191.notablePrerequisites:
You have cast at least one instant and/or sorcery spells this turn.
Bloodthirsty Conqueror has indestructible.
You control another indestructible creature.
You have a way to deal damage to Bloodthirsty Conqueror.
518-3584-6191.description:
Cast Arcbond by paying {2}{R}, targeting Bloodthirsty Conqueror.
Thousand-Year Storm triggers, copying Arcbond at least once, with the copies targeting another indestructible creature you control.
Resolve all Arcbonds.
Deal damage to Bloodthirsty Conqueror.
Arbond triggers, dealing that much damage to each player and each other creature.
Bloodthirsty Conqueror triggers for each opponent dealt damage, and Arcbond triggers due to the other indestructible creature being dealt damage.
Resolve all Bloodthirsty Conqueror triggers, causing you to gain life.
Resolve the Arcbond trigger, dealing that much damage to each player and each other creature.
Bloodthirsty Conqueror triggers for each opponent dealt damage, and Arcbond triggers due to Bloodthirsty Conqueror being dealt damage.
Resolve all Bloodthirsty Conqueror triggers, causing you to gain life.
Resolve the Arcbond trigger, dealing that much damage to each player and each other creature.
Repeat form step 6.

4374-5684-5870.description:
Activate Aethergeode Miner by paying {E}{E}, blinking it.
When Aethergeode Miner enters the battlefield, Metastatic Evangel and Guide of Souls trigger.
Resolve the Guide of Souls trigger, causing you to get {E} and gain 1 life.
Resolve the Metastatic Evangel trigger, causing you to proliferate and get {E}.
Repeat.

2173-4423-4693-4935-6491.manaNeeded: {G} if Enter the Unknown is in your hand
2173-4423-4693-4935-6491.easyPrerequisites: If Enter the Unknown is on top of your library, your life total must be at least 2.
2173-4423-4693-4935-6491.notablePrerequisites: You control three or more Islands.
2173-4423-4693-4935-6491.description:
Cast Enter the Unknown either from your hand by paying {G} or from the top of your library by paying 1 life, causing a creature you control to explore and allowing you to play an additional land this turn.
Play Mystic Sanctuary either from your hand or graveyard.
When Mystic Sanctuary enters the battlefield untapped, it triggers, putting Enter the Unknown from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Activate Mystic Sanctuary by tapping it, adding {U}.
Activate Overgrown Estate by sacrificing Mystic Sanctuary, causing you to gain 3 life.
Repeat.

uses.n: Ojer Taq, Deepest Foundation // Temple of Civilization

457-1270-1409.description:
Activate Urza by paying {1}{U}, blinking it.
When Urza enters the battlefield, it and Deadeye Navigator's soulbond ability trigger.
Resolve the Deadeye Navigator trigger, repairing it and Urza.
Resolve the Urza trigger, creating three 0/0 Construct artifact creature tokens.
Activate Urza's first ability twice by tapping two Constructs, adding {U}{U}.
Repeat.
457-1270-1409.notes: Once you have infinite mana, you may use it to activate Urza's ability.

101-957-2665.notablePrerequisites: Progenitor Mimic is a copy of Vampire Charmseeker.
101-957-2665.description:
Cast Time Stretch by paying {8}{U}{U}, taking two extra turns after this one.
At the beginning of your next upkeep, Progenitor Mimic triggers, creating a token copy of Vampire Charmseeker.
When the token Vampire Charmseeker enters the battlefield, it triggers itself, returning Time Stretch from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.

4050-4080-4417-5492-5493.notablePrerequisites: The Cruelty of Gix has exactly two lore counters on it.
4050-4080-4417-5492-5493.description:
At the beginning of your precombat main phase, The Cruelty of Gix triggers, putting a lore counter on it.
The Cruelty of Gix's third chapter ability triggers.
Holding priority, activate Hex Parasite by paying {1}{B/P} and removing a lore counter from The Cruelty of Gix, giving Hex Parasite +1/+0 until end of turn.
Resolve the Cruelty of Gix trigger from step 2, returning Hautli's Raptor from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Huatli's Raptor and Narci's second ability triggers.
Resolve the Narci trigger, causing each opponent to lose 5 life and you to gain 5 life.
Holding priority, activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Huatli's Raptor, adding {1}.
Resolve the Huatli's Raptor trigger, putting a lore counter on The Cruelty of Gix.
Repeat from step 2.

2770-3722-3903.description:
Cast Donate by paying {2}{U}, giving control of Colfenor's Plans to an opponent.
Whenever the opponent that controls Colfenor's Plans casts a spell from their hand, Knowledge Pool triggers, exiling that spell.
Because Colfenor's Plans prevents the opponent from casting more than one spell each turn, the opponent cannot cast the spell permitted by Knowledge Pool, or any other spell that turn.

1940-2034-3537-5010.description:
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Golgari Thug, adding {C}{C}.
Golgari Thug dies, triggering itself and Liliana.
Resolve the Golgari Thug trigger, putting itself on top of your library from your graveyard.
Resolve the Liliana trigger, causing you to draw Golgari Thug from the top of your library.
Activate Bog Initiate by paying {1}, adding {B}.
Cast Golgari Thug by paying {1}{B}.
Repeat.

1376-3464-3657.notablePrerequisites: There are at least five Elves on the battlefield.
1376-3464-3657.description:
Activate Priest of Titania by tapping it, adding at least {G}{G}{G}{G}{G}.
Cast Hyrax Tower Scout by paying {2}{G}.
When Hyrax Tower Scout enters the battlefield, it triggers, untapping Priest of Titania.
Activate Kogla by paying {1}{G}, returning Hyrax Tower Scout from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat.
1376-3464-3657.notes: If you get infinite mana, you can repeat steps 2-5 infinitely to untap any other creature(s)

24-1167-4838.description:
Activate Mindslaver by paying {4}, tapping and sacrificing it, causing you to gain control of target opponent during their next turn.
Move to the opponent's turn.
Cast Wheel of Misfortune by paying {2}{R}, selecting an arbitrarily large number for the opponent you control, and dealing that much damage to the opponent  if the oponent chose the largest number.
If the opponent didn't choose the largest number, Wheel of Misfortune deals that much damage to each opponent who chose the largest number.

933-2724-3217.description:
Blink Wormfang Manta using Conjurer's Closet. Wormfang Manta's first ability won't trigger due to Tocatli Honor Guard.
Wormfang Manta's second ability triggers, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Repeat each turn.
